revisionDesc.change: Finalized - done

Vote - AcceptText - Following discussion with CB, we agreed that ἀ̣ρ̣χ̣ does not account for all the traces, while ἀ̣ρχ̣ε̣φ̣[όδο]υ (BL 8.199) is not a viable reading. The original suggestion has now been changed to four dots, which may conceal the name of Makarios's father.

Vote - AcceptText - Both corrections look good to me, but the epsilon in (ἑ̣ξ(ῆς)) in l. 4 doesn't need to be dotted. || There are some typos in the BL entries that need to be fixed before finalizing: ll. 4–5: BL 5.51 => BL 5.61; ll. 5–6: BL 6.51 => BL 5.61; l. 17: BL.61 => BL 5.61
Submit - Integration of BL 8 corrections, a few minor additional changes.

Commit - I've integrated BL 8 corrections for lin1, 4-5, and 22 (verso). Reg. the BL 8 correction of Ἁ̣ρ̣σ̣ι̣ε̣φ̣ to ἀ̣ρχ̣ε̣φ̣[όδο]υ in lin4, the space is not so generous, and what has been taken for ἀρ is likely the upsilon of Μακαρίου and the long extension of the rho from λαμπρ in lin3 (cf. the long rho in lin17 ἐπερωτηθείς). Therefore, the beginning of the word should be read after this extension as ἀ̣ρ̣. The exact way this is abbreviated is not clear, probably ἀρχ( ) (not much space left before ἑξ(ῆς)), hence the dots, but from the verso we know he's an ἀρχέφοδος. In lin6 λ̣ιβός => λιβό<ς>, sigma was forgotten.
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine.
